description: Adamjee Insurance Company Limited is a general insurance company in Pakistan, incorporated as a public listed company on 28 September 1960 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It has a regional presence in the United Arab Emirates and writes a diversified portfolio spanning motor, travel, health, property, marine and engineering risks, with a particular standing in oil and gas, wind and thermal energy risks. Its life assurance operations are carried on under a separate entity, Adamjee Life Assurance Company Limited, and Shariah-compliant cover is offered through its Window Takaful Operations.
